post_title: B1B2 visa rejected for my parents in delhi. They did not get telugu translator.
concerns_or_questions_summary: Telugu-speaking father and 75-year-old grandmother were refused B-1/B-2 visas at the New Delhi consulate on April 21, 2026 after requesting but not receiving a Telugu interpreter and being interviewed only in English. The user (H-1B daughter sponsoring the visit) asks whether the lack of a translator impacted the decision, how long to wait before reapplying, what to change, and whether to reapply separately or together.
